news.headline: What to Expect From UniQure's Upcoming Huntington's Gene Therapy Readout
news.summary: STAT previewed uniQure's still-pending four-year AMT-130 data, noting the analysis will benchmark against an expanded ~26,000-patient Enroll-HD comparator cohort to address the FDA's prior critique of the smaller matched-control group used in the 36-month readout. The piece frames the four-year data as the key test of whether the 75% disease-slowing signal seen at three years holds up.

news.headline: Analysts Set uniQure N.V. (QURE) Price Target at $65.00
news.summary: Sell-side analysts raised price targets on QURE following the BLA/MAA filings, with consensus around $65-73 citing improved visibility on the accelerated-approval pathway. William Blair resumed coverage on Sept 2 with an Outperform rating and $73 fair value estimate.

news.headline: AdCom Expected for uniQure's Huntington's Gene Therapy, Chief Medical Officer Says
news.summary: uniQure CMO Walid Abi-Saab said the company expects the FDA will convene an advisory committee meeting on AMT-130 and is preparing for it, though no date has been set. The article notes uniQure "welcomes" the scrutiny as a chance to build public confidence in the data package.

news.headline: uniQure Filed for Huntington's Approval. Acceptance Is the Catalyst, Analyst Says
news.summary: Analysts flagged FDA's 60-day filing-acceptance decision (expected early November) as the next near-term catalyst after the Sept 2 BLA submission, alongside the still-outstanding four-year data. Coverage highlighted that priority review, if granted, would compress the review clock toward a mid-2027 approval decision.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Submission of Biologics License Application for Ifezuntirgene Inilparvovec (AMT-130) in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: uniQure submitted a U.S. BLA (requesting priority review) and, in parallel, a UK MHRA Marketing Authorisation Application for AMT-130, both built on the 3-year Phase I/II efficacy and safety data. The company reiterated that a separate four-year data update remains on track before the end of Q3 2026.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported cash, equivalents and investments of $810.3M (runway into 2030) after its June 2026 upsized $810M offering, with Q2 net loss of $81.1M. Management reaffirmed Q3 2026 BLA/MAA filing plans and guided to four-year AMT-130 topline data before end of September 2026.

catalysts.when: Before end of September 2026 (guided; NOT yet released as of Sep 21, 2026)
catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 topline data readout
catalysts.detail: The single biggest near-term catalyst. As of Sept 21, 2026 uniQure has NOT yet released the 48-month follow-up data (12 high-dose / 12 low-dose patients, plus 3 additional high-dose patients at 3 years), benchmarked against an expanded ~26,000-patient Enroll-HD comparator. Company last reaffirmed the guidance in its Sept 2 BLA-filing release; no release has been confirmed in the days since. Watch closely — this is now due within days.

catalysts.label: FDA BLA filing acceptance & priority review decision
catalysts.detail: FDA's standard 60-day filing review of the Sept 2, 2026 BLA submission for AMT-130; uniQure requested priority review, which would compress the subsequent review to ~6 months.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA MAA review outcome / milestones
catalysts.detail: MHRA is reviewing the parallel Marketing Authorisation Application submitted Sept 2, 2026 following a positive pre-submission meeting; no formal decision date has been disclosed.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA Advisory Committee (AdCom) meeting
catalysts.detail: Company management expects an AdCom will be convened on AMT-130 and says it is preparing for one, but no date has been scheduled.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next scheduled quarterly update; will likely include commentary on BLA filing status, the four-year data (if released by then) and AdCom scheduling.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Would make AMT-130 the first approved gene therapy / disease-modifying treatment for Huntington's disease if the accelerated approval pathway is granted.

pulse: The single biggest catalyst — uniQure's four-year AMT-130 topline readout, guided for 'before end of September 2026' — had STILL NOT been released as of September 21, 2026, despite the company reaffirming the timeline as recently as its Sept 2 BLA-filing press release; with only days left in the quarter, this is now imminent and warrants close monitoring. Since the Sept 2 dual filing (US BLA with priority-review request + UK MHRA MAA), sentiment has been constructive: analysts (William Blair, others) raised price targets into the $65-73 range on improved regulatory visibility, and management says it expects and is preparing for an FDA advisory committee meeting. Near-term catalysts stack up in sequence — the overdue four-year data, then FDA's ~early-November filing-acceptance/priority-review decision, then AdCom scheduling — making QURE a high-catalyst-density name through year-end.
